plan_requirement: S1-013 / QA-PROC-002 require selectable methods, reproducible parameters and matrix changes, sample factors and explicit scales/order. The cached plan does not prescribe a Median formula.

chosen_convention.scale: log2 in and log2 out; consume already-saved complete positive-log2/None result
chosen_convention.sample_median: m_j = stats::median(x_ij for observed finite cells of sample j)
chosen_convention.reference: r = stats::median(m_j), one equal weight per sample; not pooled across cells
order: add one offset to each finite observed sample cell
retain NA, original masks and no-imputation state
chosen_convention.even_count_rule: stats::median default midpoint of the two central observations
chosen_convention.factor: additive_offset_log2; not a multiplicative raw-scale factor

inputs.working: Full saved working-matrix loaded as data.frame: exact record_number / protein_ids_raw prefix followed by every selected sample in saved order; numeric sample columns with finite values or NA_real_. NaN/Inf rejected. Negative and zero log2 values are valid observed values.
inputs.identity: Unique increasing original source record_number, duplicate and multi-member protein_ids_raw retained verbatim, exact full sample column names. sample_ordinal is the 1-based selected-matrix order, not original raw-table column_ordinal.
inputs.masks: original_blank/original_zero/working_NA/imputed data.frames, exact same prefix/order/shape; logical no-NA values. Original blank and zero disjoint; working_NA equals their union and numeric NA. imputed entirely FALSE.
inputs.provenance: Existing full parent metadata retained unchanged under result.provenance.parent; requires canonical project and processed version UUID, manifest SHA256, artifact name/bytes/SHA256 pins and prior positive_only/log2/normalization none/imputation none/zero and blank to_NA/pseudocount 0 parameters.
inputs.byte_integrity_boundary: This pure numeric core checks metadata shape, not artifact-byte SHA256, owner rights, full parent schema or R execution authority. A future trusted coordinator must first read the full persisted parent, validate its existing model, verify all complete bytes against manifest, decode numbers/masks without losing raw IDs, and pin execution. No client authorization Boolean is accepted.

conditions.single_observation: Mathematically defined but emits sample_with_single_observation; no statistical readiness claim.
conditions.all_NA_sample_median: Whole operation fails insufficient_observed_values; no sample deletion/filling/fallback.
conditions.all_NA_row: Retained with original row ID and NA mask unchanged.
conditions.none: Exact input working data.frame and masks retained; offsets all zero; reference NA; all-NA columns allowed, matching existing None semantics.
conditions.imputed_input: Any TRUE imputed mask refuses unsupported_imputed_input; only the existing no-imputation parent is supported.
conditions.overflow: Nonfinite derived reference, offsets or finite-cell results refuse rather than publish partial success.

outputs.working_matrix: Complete transformed data.frame; exact prefix/full sample order; NA locations unchanged.
outputs.factors: Per-sample ordinal/name, observed/missing/imputed/original blank/original zero counts, input median, reference, additive log2 offset and output median.
outputs.parameters: Exact method/formula/reference/scales/minimum observations/order contract; separate from the unchanged older normalization-none validator schema.
outputs.provenance: Full parent, exact rows/sample names, input-output counts, R/stats versions; byte_integrity_attested/owner_authorized/published FALSE; output_artifact_pins NULL until future byte coordinator serializes and hashes all actual output artifacts.
outputs.persistence: Returned in-memory result only. No new ProcessedDatasetVersion publication or old parent modification.

verification.fixture: All 11 existing synthetic saved-log2 LFQ artifact bytes pinned before and after execution; the full four-row/two-sample working matrix and four masks are decoded by R, parameters are cross-checked by the target bridge, and other artifact pins remain in parent provenance.
verification.expectations: Literal independent numeric expected matrix/medians/reference/offsets; unequal-count three-sample example distinguishes sample-equal reference from pooled-cell reference; None/NA/duplicates/counts/minimum observations/unsupported input checks.
verification.output_byte_pins: Actual target serialization is SHA256-pinned in target-evidence-001/target-receipt.json, not claimed as a production artifact format.
verification.startup_locale_warnings: Four C.UTF-8 locale setup warnings captured unchanged; target still exited 0. No warning suppression or retest.
